common.unauthorized: Not authorised: open Rhizome from the link printed by `rhz serve` or from the desktop app.
common.unreachable: The backend is not reachable (it may be restarting). Try again in a few seconds.
common.page_error: This page hit an error. The other pages still work.

search.empty_hint: Try fewer filters, an accession, or a method name.

home.ingest_hint: Drop an RXF file exported from Claude or ChatGPT, or save it into the inbox folder.
home.drop: Drop RXF files (several at once, optionally with same-named PDFs) here or click to choose
home.recall_placeholder: Paste an analysis plan, a paragraph or code…
home.recall_go: What have I read that helps?
home.tagline: What have you already read that helps right now?
home.tagline_sub: Papers you discussed, split into datasets, methods, ideas and claims — searchable, linked, and brought back when they matter.
home.step1: Discuss a paper in Claude or ChatGPT, with the Rhizome export instructions in the Project (Settings → Chat Project setup copies them in one click).
home.step2: Save the YAML into the inbox folder or drop it here. Invalid files come back with a report to paste into the chat.
home.step3: Search by asset, open topic pages, and let recall surface what you forgot.
home.recall_hint: Paste what you are working on; Rhizome ranks your own assets by relevance × how long since you last saw them.
home.recall_empty_hint: Nothing above the relevance threshold. Try a more specific description.
home.drop_not_rxf: No RXF export found: the content must start with rxf_version: 1 (any file name or extension); a same-named PDF may come along
home.repairable: This is a known export drift and can be repaired on import: {{fixes}}. The original file is kept and the repair is recorded in L1.
home.failed_hint: Edit the file and click "Import again", or use "Repair and import" for known export drift.

fix.rxf_version_type: read the quoted rxf_version as a number

home.inbox_pending: {{n}} inbox files are waiting (retried automatically while the library is busy or a model is missing): {{files}}
home.inbox_ignored: {{n}} inbox files are not RXF exports and were skipped: {{files}}
home.vocab_stale: The topic vocabulary has changed since you last put it into the Project.

paper.suspect: IDs that could not be verified and were not stored: {{ids}}

topic.reject_confirm: Hide the topic “{{name}}” everywhere? (undo under Decisions)
topic.merge_placeholder: topic key or name to merge into

map.title: Topic map
map.empty: No topics yet. Ingest a few RXF exports first.
map.new_topic_hint: The whole library is retro-tagged with the new topic; uncertain matches go to the review queue.
map.name: Name (short English noun phrase)
map.created: Topic created; retro-tagging runs in the background.
map.sub: Only the topic layer is drawn; node size is the number of linked assets, colour is the community.
map.legend: Pale = candidate topic · click a node to open its page · hover to highlight neighbours
map.empty_hint: Topics appear as RXF exports mention them; confirm or create them to make them official.

review.title: Review queue
review.keys: Keyboard: j / k to move, 1–5 to choose an action, s to skip.
review.synthesis_note: What is the connection, and which problem could it help with? (becomes an Idea)

question.synthesis: Is the link between “{{a_name}}” and “{{b_name}}” useful?

review.empty_hint: New items arrive as papers are ingested and when topics are created.
review.dismiss_confirm: Skip all {{n}} pending items of this kind?

cards.title: Review cards
cards.sub: Space shows the answer; 1–4 grades it.
cards.done_hint: Cards come from deep exports; new ones are limited per day in Settings.
cards.never_confirm: Stop making cards about “{{name}}”? Its other cards are suspended too.
cards.learning_hint: Cards graded Again return after their learning step (next in about {{min}} min). Keep this page open or come back.

digest.title: Weekly digest
digest.hint: Close assets with no path between them, from different communities. Ask Claude (rhz_digest) to explain the promising ones.
digest.no_pairs_hint: Run the batch, or wait for the weekly synthesis.
digest.note_placeholder: What connects them, and which problem might it help? (saved as your idea when marked useful)

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_hint: Paper content and your notes are never translated.
settings.models_hint: Models are downloaded on first use and can be switched off individually. Thresholds must be re-calibrated after switching.
settings.rebuild_hint: After changing models, recompute the graph from stored exports.
settings.remotes_hint: Targets for `rhz sync <name>`: name, host, path, optional control_path to reuse an authenticated SSH connection.
settings.vocab_hint: Put rhizome-vocab.yaml into the Claude / ChatGPT Project knowledge after topics change.
settings.portable_hint: Portable installation: all data is kept in the data folder next to the app.
settings.move_hint: Move the library to another folder (e.g. another drive or a synced folder). Existing data is copied; the old folder is left untouched. Restart the app afterwards.
settings.dir_moved: Library is now at {{dir}}. Restart Rhizome to use it.
settings.dir_same: That is already the current folder.
settings.claude_hint: Adds Rhizome as an MCP server to Claude Desktop, so Claude can save papers, recall assets and work through the review queue. Other servers in the config are kept.
settings.models_not_installed: This build ships with the built-in lightweight models only. bge-m3, the reranker and NLI need the Python model packages, which are too large to bundle.
settings.backups_hint: The library is backed up once a day (whenever the last daily backup is older than 20 hours); the newest 14 daily backups are kept and manual backups are never deleted. Point the backup folder at another disk or a synced cloud folder: backups are closed, complete copies and safe to sync, unlike the live data folder.
settings.backups_dir_placeholder: e.g. D:\Backups\Rhizome or a folder in your cloud drive (empty = backups inside the data folder)
settings.dir_claude_updated: The Claude Desktop config now follows the new location too; restart Claude Desktop.
settings.project_hint: Create a Project in Claude or ChatGPT: paste the export instructions into the Project instructions and add the topic vocabulary rhizome-vocab.yaml to the Project knowledge. Then say "export RXF" after each discussion. When Rhizome is connected to Claude Desktop, Claude can also fetch the instructions itself with rhz_rxf_guide.
settings.restore_hint: Close Rhizome and Claude Desktop, then run these in a terminal: the first lists the backups, the second replaces the library with the one you pick. The state before the restore is saved first, so you can go back.
settings.contact_email_hint: With an address, OpenAlex and NCBI put requests in their more reliable 'polite pool' with fewer rate limits. It is only sent to those two services. Behind a campus or company proxy, set HTTPS_PROXY and restart the app; `rhz doctor` checks the network.
settings.network_failing: {{host}}: {{failed}} recent requests failed ({{ok}} succeeded). Affected ids are kept as 'unverified', never dropped, and checked again later.
settings.lexical_only: Built-in model: matching is lexical only (synonyms, acronyms and Chinese/English pairs are not merged; they are queued for review when the initials match).

models.unavailable: The models chosen in settings ({{models}}) cannot be loaded by this program, so importing and searching will fail. The installed desktop app runs the built-in models only.
models.switched: Switched to the built-in models; rebuilding in the background.
models.index_stale: The library's vectors were made with {{index}}; the current model is {{current}}. Rebuild once to resume searching and importing.

jobs.rebuilding_banner: The library is being rebuilt. You can browse and search meanwhile; changes are paused (dropped files are processed when it finishes).

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.hint: Your merges, renames, rejections, withdrawn exports and other decisions, newest first. Undoing one rebuilds the library from the rest.
decisions.confirm: Undo decision #{{id}}? The library is rebuilt in the background.

edit.title: Edit
edit.rename_placeholder: New name (the old one stays an alias)
edit.alias_placeholder: Another name, abbreviation or Chinese name
edit.merge_placeholder: Entry of the same type to merge into (type to search, pick its key)
edit.merge_confirm: Merge this entry into {{into}}? You can undo it under Decisions.
edit.reject_confirm: A rejected asset no longer appears in search, recall, datasets or reviews. You can undo it under Decisions.
edit.retract_confirm: The paper's exports stop contributing to the graph (raw files are kept) and the library is rebuilt. You can undo it under Decisions.

mode.read_only: Read-only (a remote snapshot): browse and search, no changes.
mode.moved: The library was moved to {{path}}. Restart to continue there; changes are paused until then.
